name: What materials are commonly used for pergolas and which is best for the Las Vegas climate?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for pergolas and which is best for the Las Vegas climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pergola materials include wood (cedar, redwood, pressure-treated pine) and aluminum. Wood offers a classic, natural aesthetic but requires more maintenance, especially in the dry Las Vegas climate, to prevent warping and cracking. Aluminum is a popular choice for its durability, low maintenance, and resistance to pests and rot, making it well-suited for the desert environment. Vinyl pergolas are also available, offering a maintenance-free option with a clean look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood and aluminum are common pergola materials. Aluminum is often preferred for the Las Vegas climate due to its durability and low maintenance, resisting pests and rot.
